class.name: MFCCProcessor
class.brief_description: Implements a Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) feature extractor.
class.description: An MFCC feature extraction algorithm. An MFCC is similar to a spectrogram, but it is more compact and mimics the human auditory system. It can be used with [DTWMatcher] for keyword spotting.

method.name: compute
method.description: Computes the MFCC features for the given audio sample. The sample is expected to be a 1D [PackedFloat32Array] each value in [code][-1.0, 1.0][/code]. The output is a 2D array ([Array] of [PackedFloat32Array]) where each row is a frame and each column is a coefficient.

members.member: The length of each frame in samples, a longer frame length will give more frequency resolution but less time resolution.
The number of samples between the start of each frame. A smaller hop length will give more time resolution but less frequency resolution.
The number of MFCC coefficients to compute. The more coefficients, the more information is captured, but it will also be more sensitive to noise.
The number of Mel frequency bands to use. The more bands, the more information is captured, but it will also be more sensitive to noise.
The sample rate of the audio signal in Hz. This should match the sample rate of the input audio.
